scope: Minecraft 1.21.1 native font asset-derived typography audit for the current Thaumonomicon EN/RU strings

modern_font_exception.policy: Use the active native Minecraft 1.21.1 font and honor Force Unicode Font. No legacy 1.12 font provider, glyph-size binary, or legacy font texture is introduced. Historical artwork remains separate from this font exception.

method.classification: Offline Python reconstruction from actual local native font assets, not a live Minecraft 1.21.1 Font-engine execution or screenshot validation.
method.bitmap_advance: floor(0.5 + rightmost_nontransparent_column_exclusive * (provider_height / source_cell_height)) + 1; first applicable native bitmap provider wins.
method.unihex_advance: floor(nonempty_horizontal_span / 2) + 1; Latin/Cyrillic measured here use no CJK size override.
method.style_processing: Legacy section-sign formatting is decoded; color/reset clears bold; bold adds provider-specific offset; @@ legacy tooltip markers are removed. Italic changes ink projection but not measured advance.
method.wrapping: Minecraft StringSplitter.LineBreakFinder-style greedy codepoint accumulation: overflow only after at least one nonzero-width glyph; break at last ASCII space when possible; preserve blank tooltip lines. Widths are logical GUI units, not physical pixels.
limits: Default vanilla 1.21.1 assets and current bundled EN/RU strings only; replacement resource-pack glyph metrics can differ.
Text advance boxes are measured, not GPU ink coverage.
Selected live-client screenshots separately validate layout; full catalog statistics remain offline reconstructions.
Same-language resource reload is verified; arbitrary resource-pack replacement glyph shapes are outside these screenshots.

instability.separator_note: The current source concatenates tc.inst + one literal space + tc.inst.N. tc.inst already ends with a space in both EN/RU; measured output therefore contains TWO spaces. Section-sign color codes have zero advance.

minimum_main_to_first_component_case.note: Both widths are even, so Java integer division does not change this existing gap. The final Fabrico pair shift has a separate 4px main-to-first gap.

fabrico_gui_1_geometry.note: The final shift clamps against the real opaque parchment edge +93, not the transparent texture quad +127. Font.width already includes the last glyph advance. Both component icons/labels and the plus sign move together; the main aspect remains fixed.

native_pixel_grid.scale_formula: Default decorative scale = ceil(guiScale * 0.5) / guiScale; forced Unicode decorative scale = 1.
native_pixel_grid.note: Native unihex has 2x oversampling, so GUI scale 3 retains native 1.5px source-pixel mapping. No extra half-size transform is applied to forced-Unicode text.

production_adaptations.change: Native 1x style-aware tooltip text, removal of legacy @@ scale markers, original TC6 frame colors, width wrapping and viewport clamping. Actual measured catalogs fit; no arbitrary scrolling or font replacement introduced.

Native title wrapping preserves a short trailing parenthesized suffix where possible without adding lines; reserve native title height. Decorative scale rounds to whole physical pixels and forced Unicode remains 1x. GUI1 component labels spread only for actual overlap, then shift only for opaque paper overflow.
Native styled font-width pagination is cached by text/layout/resource/language/uniform state; screen init forcibly invalidates the cache after resource reload.

Recipe header uses native wrapping at 186 GUI px, keeping the last line at its original y and placing extra lines upward so the output slot is not obscured. Only the default RU shapeless arcane label exceeds 186px in the bundled catalog.
Long research title and completion header remain native-size with wrapped lines and a vertically extended original HUD frame instead of fractional text shrinking.
